dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: This multi-output process 'mining and refining, gold-silver deposit' delivers the two co-products 'gold, from combined gold-silver-production, at refinery' and 'silver, from combined gold-silver-production, at refinery'. This data set includes the mining in Papua New Guinea in open pit mines incl. land use. Air emissions are estimated.; UUID: fe11193a-6eab-3e28-af64-e02c18271011

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:

# Included processes
This data set includes the combined mining and refining of gold and silver in open pit mines in Papua New Guinea incl. energy and material use, water and air emissions of metals and land use.
